description: Record a person's answer to one open product choice in the local intent.md, or take an answer back. Local mode only. Call it once per choice the person has explicitly answered, with their own words for THAT choice in answer, parents before the choices that depend on them. One message may answer several choices; each still gets its own call and its own quoted words. A blanket "go with the recommendations" is not an answer to any choice: ask about each one, recommendation first, and never offer to accept them all at once. Set humanApproved only after the person has answered the choice you are recording. The answer is written the way a workspace review writes one (the accepted claims enter the spec, a decision is logged), marked answered locally (unverified), and bound to the choice text: editing the choice afterwards reopens it. It is the local record of a conversation, not verified approval, and it does not authorize anything for a team. Actions: use (accept the recommendation), change (a different answer: pass alternative), exclude (leave the behavior out, with a reason), defer (leave it open), reopen (take a recorded answer back, removing what it added). change is also how a flagged outcome claim is corrected, since a saved choice cannot be edited: keep the person's answer as alternative.answer and give the measurable outcome in alternative.claims.

action.description: use: accept the recommendation. change: record the different answer in alternative. exclude: do not build this behavior. defer: leave it open. reopen: take back a recorded answer.

answer.description: The answer the person chose instead of the recommendation.

claims.description: What this answer adds to the spec: outcomes, constraints, or edge cases (an edge case needs a scenario).

reopenTrigger.description: What would make this worth deciding again.

answer.description: The person's own words for this choice, quoted. Required for use, change and exclude.

choiceId.description: The product choice id, as it appears in intent.md productChoices.

humanApproved.description: Set ONLY after the person has explicitly answered this choice. Required for use, change and exclude. Recorded as an answer this environment cannot verify.

path.description: Path to the intent file. Defaults to the one check_intent_readiness reads: intent.md at the root, else the single intent/**/intent.md.

reason.description: Why, in the person's terms. Required for change and exclude.

name: answer_product_choice
title: Record an answer to a product choice
